The '''Qu'mock system''' was in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], and was controlled by the [[Qektoth Confederation]]. The [[Qektoth Confederation Space Station]] orbited a planet there. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] corvette ''[[FarStar]]'' [[Battle of Qu'mock|engaged]] a [[Qektoth attack cruiser]] in the system.
